title: `-x` silently overrides `--ali-out`, `--tbl-out` and `--tbl-format`
body:
With `-x`, `SearchArgs::validate` (nail/src/args.rs) sets the tabular output path to `None`, and alignments go to stdout, whatever `--tbl-out`, `--tbl-format` or `--ali-out` say. clap accepts these combinations without a word.

## Proposal

Declare `conflicts_with_all` on `-x` for the three flags, so clap rejects the combination.

## Cost

A script that passes `-x` with one of them stops working.
close_reason: -x carries conflicts_with_all for the three flags and --tbl-out drops its default under -x via default_value_if, in nail/src/args.rs. Committed on dev.
